text.tspan: IAM role: temporary permissions for an AWS service (EC2 → S3 example)
User = one person, long-term credentials (password / access keys). Role = no long-term credentials, anyone TRUSTED can wear it for a while.
Common roles: EC2 instance role · Lambda execution role · ECS task role · cross-account access · federation / SSO (IAM Identity Center).
To attach a role to EC2 you need iam:PassRole. A role has TWO policies: trust (who) + permissions (what).
Trap: a role does NOT need access keys, and you never store keys on an instance; you can swap the role on a running instance.
